persos.pose: standing in the middle next to the pot, holding the ladle, suspicious

persos.desc: woman in her 40s, sky-blue-and-chocolate pagne dress, big earrings, holding ONE single empty plate
persos.pose: standing on the left, holding her empty plate, relaxed

persos.desc: husband in his 30s, ruby-and-navy polo shirt, skinny, hopeful eyes
persos.pose: sitting at the small table in the foreground on the right, hands flat on the table

dialogue: Tantie, pourquoi tu arrives toujours quand je cuisine-là ?!
Ton mari m'écrit SOS chaque fois que tu cuisines dêh.
Et ce soir, apporte ta sauce.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The cooking wife points the ladle at the neighbor, suspicious. The neighbor lifts her empty plate and answers calmly, nodding toward the husband. The hungry husband, seated, leans toward the neighbor and says his line in a pleading whisper, his face clearly visible.
chute: The wife slowly turns toward her husband, the ladle frozen in the air. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the hungry husband's guilty face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA LOUCHE APRÈS CETTE TRAHISON :
mecanisme: révélation de la complicité du mari + relance assassine : il commande carrément la sauce de la voisine

lieu: small house in a shared courtyard in Williamsville, Abidjan, a thin wall with an open window onto the neighbor's house, a plastic chair, evening

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, turquoise-and-sand shirt, small moustache, worn leather shoes
persos.pose: sitting on the plastic chair in the foreground on the left, leaning toward his wife

persos.desc: wife in her 40s, burgundy-and-gold tunic, headscarf, holding ONE single empty market basket
persos.pose: standing in the middle, holding the empty basket

persos.desc: woman in her 50s, teal-and-violet house dress, big round glasses, sly look
persos.pose: leaning in the open window on the right, head and shoulders visible, listening

dialogue: Parle doucement, chérie. La voisine-là écoute tout dêh.
Ya fohi. Donc tu as l'argent du marché ?
Non bébé, j'ai pas un franc dêh.
Il ment. Chaussure gauche, ma sœur.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The husband leans toward his wife and whispers his warning. The wife answers in a low voice, holding the empty basket. The husband opens his empty hands and shakes his head sadly. The neighbor at the window raises one finger and says her line, her face clearly visible.
chute: The husband freezes and slowly looks down at his left shoe while his wife stares at it. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the whispering husband's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA CHAUSSURE GAUCHE APRÈS CETTE RÉPONSE :
mecanisme: témoin caché qui écoutait tout + relance assassine : elle balance la cachette exacte de l'argent
